//: Rare end-game spear that runs on a medium battery. Use it to switch it on (xa_shock_lance_on): electric damage on every hit and a 1-in-3 stun. Sibling of the Flamero-Mado spear. Found in labs, military gear and prison armouries; crafted only from xa_shock_lance_schematic.
description: A long steel lance with a slim point flanked by two short copper electrodes.  Copper coils ring the pale enamelled shaft, a battery pack with a little green light sits under your rear hand, and white ceramic insulators guard the grip from the business end.  Switch it on and the head crackles with current that leaps into whatever you stab.  Switched off, it is still a fine spear.

use_action.msg: You thumb the switch.  The coils whine and blue sparks snap between the electrodes.

//: On: electric damage on every hit, about 1 hit in 3 stuns (on-hit spell xa_shock_lance_stun, once_in 3), a faint blue light, 25 W from its battery; switches itself off when the battery runs flat. SPAWN_ACTIVE: a transformed item is only processed (draws power) with it.
description: A long steel lance with blue current crawling between the electrodes at its head.  Every thrust shocks as well as pierces, and now and then the jolt locks up whatever you hit.  Use it to switch it off.

use_action.msg: You thumb the switch and the crackle dies away.

//: Cast by a switched-on shock lance on what it hits (about 1 hit in 3): stuns it for 1-2 turns. Not learnable; no Magiclysm needed. Things immune to electricity (the Redeemer, robots) shrug it off.

description.str: The jolt locks up whatever you hit.  You should never see this as a spell.

//: The only way to learn the shock lance recipe. Spawns with the lance's caches.
description: A thick wad of wiring diagrams in a static bag, stamped PROTOTYPE - CROWD CONTROL - DO NOT DUPLICATE.  The coils, the capacitor bank and the two electrodes are drawn in loving detail; someone has written "why is it a SPEAR" in the margin.

//: End-game: Electronics 7, Fabrication 6 and soldering, and only from the schematic. The battery is not used up; it comes as the lance's default magazine slot (empty).
A found shock lance: a part-charged battery in it, and usually its schematic with it.
Additions: a shock lance in a lab, about 1 roll in 200.
Additions: a shock lance with military gear, about 1 roll in 200.
Additions: a crowd-control prototype in a prison armoury, about 1 roll in 200.
